studies.title: Steamships across the ocean
studies.caption: The Great Western crosses from Bristol to New York in fifteen days under steam, on a regular service.
studies.prompt: Low three-quarter harbor view of Great Western in1838, long wooden hull, large side paddle boxes and central funnel, four masts with sails mostly furled; modest coal smoke, workers on quay. Side-wheel paddle propulsion, not screw propeller or twentieth-century ocean liner.
